what: Two layers of the steer lens timed on the home RTX 5090: `atlas_build.py steer` at layer 45 (29 October 2026, 00:26-00:31 CDT) and at layer 5 (the same day, 14:52-15:13 CDT, the machine otherwise idle), layers from 0, --unpacker compiled, each written into a scratch folder and not served. Quoted in COMPUTE §i and ROADMAP §vi.
what_it_ran: build_steer_layer pushes each batch of neurons, both signs, on four contexts, and runs only the layers after the pushed one (backend/atlas_build.py: ao.forward_from_layer(lm, l + 1, ...); atlas_ops.forward_from_layer loops from start to the last layer). Layer 45 of 0-59 runs the 14 after it.

all_60_inferred.rule: a layer's cost grows with the layers after it: layer l runs 59 - l of them, 1,770 layer-forwards over all 60
all_60_inferred.checked: layer 5 took 1,181 s where layer 45's rate (287 s / 14 = 20.5 s a layer-forward) gives 1,107 s, 7% more; its own rate is 21.9 s a layer-forward
all_60_inferred.arithmetic: 20.5 x 1,770 = 36,285 s (10.1 h) by layer 45's rate; 21.9 x 1,770 = 38,711 s (10.8 h) by layer 5's; a line through both, cost = a + b (59 - l), gives b = 22.35 s, a = -25.9 s and 38,006 s (10.6 h)
all_60_inferred.earlier: before layer 5 was timed: 10.1 hours from layer 45 alone, and scripts/pod/pod_tool.py's 9.7 (287 x sum(60 - l) / (60 - 45))
all_60_inferred.status: inferred from two timed layers, not run whole
